text: {"observations":"Continuous, stationary broadband noise spans the whole 10 s with no onsets or gaps. Energy sits in fixed horizontal bands (~600 Hz, ~1.6 kHz, ~2.4 kHz, faint ~6.6 kHz) and there is a thin constant tonal line near 200 Hz in the zoom. There is little energy below ~300 Hz and no gusty low-frequency fluctuation, which argues against wind. No harmonic stacks with pitch glides or syllabic modulation, which rules out a meow or human voice. The steady resonant bands plus a constant tone suggest a machine-like drone, so Mechanisms is the best fit.","answer":"A"}
